clue.text: Mate taking steps to find 'a route to the quarter-deck

parts.note: a mate is a companion or friend
a set of steps is a ladder

explanation.surface: A sailor with his mate climbs a flight of steps up to the officers' deck.
explanation.walkthrough: A companion ladder is the ship's stairway from one deck to another, typically up to the quarter-deck.
explanation.definitionFit: On a ship this stairway leads from the lower deck up to the quarter-deck where officers stand.

clue.text: Solid young thing in charge.

parts.note: a cub is a young animal such as a fox or bear

explanation.surface: A dependable youngster has been put in charge.
explanation.definitionFit: Cubic describes a three-dimensional shape, as a solid has volume.

clue.text: Declares cargo invoices

definitions.meaning: to declare openly is to show or display plainly
lists of a ship's cargo handed to customs

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means displays or declares; as a noun the shipping documents listing cargo for customs.

clue.text: Further section. of a royal society's constitution.

indicators.note: a section of these words is taken, the letters running across the word break

explanation.surface: Another clause is added to the rules of a royal society.
explanation.definitionFit: Also and further are both adverbs meaning in addition.

clue.text: Little things at home, having parties.

parts.note: being at home is being in
religious or political parties or factions are sects

explanation.surface: Children at home are throwing parties.
explanation.definitionFit: Insects are tiny creatures, little things that crawl and fly.

clue.text: Top man in the main.

parts.note: the main is a poetic word for the sea, so its top man is the Roman god ruling the sea

explanation.definitionFit: The Roman sea god rules the oceans, poetically called the main.

clue.text: A real bat's made of this soft stuff

indicators.note: the bat is made of rearranged letters, so these words are reworked

explanation.surface: A real bat made from soft white stone would be an odd thing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'made of' signals that the letters of A REAL BATS are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Alabaster is a soft translucent mineral used for carving ornaments.

clue.text: This lama's a religious leader a boy who turns out first class.

indicators.note: the boy and his article turn round, so the run is read backwards

parts.note: a lad is a boy
A1 means first class, written AI

explanation.surface: A Buddhist leader is said to have been a promising boy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'who turns out' turns A LAD round to DALA.
explanation.definitionFit: The Dalai Lama is the spiritual head of Tibetan Buddhism.

clue.text: Revolutionary landlord deserving to be specially remembered?

parts.note: a communist revolutionary is a Red
a landlord lets property, so is a letter

explanation.surface: A communist landlord who deserves to be remembered.
explanation.walkthrough: A red-letter day is one marked in red on the calendar as special.
explanation.definitionFit: Festivals were printed in red ink on calendars, marking memorable occasions.

clue.text: Extra payments as a result of good foreign customs.

parts.note: bon is French for good
customs or habits are uses

explanation.surface: Extra money paid as a result of good customs duties abroad.
explanation.definitionFit: Bonuses are additional sums paid on top of normal wages.

clue.text: Fruit was in the van, in a decorated form.

parts.note: a pear is a fruit
to be in the van (vanguard) is to lead, so led

explanation.surface: Fruit went in the van to market, decoratively packed.
explanation.definitionFit: Something pearled is adorned with pearls or pearl-like drops.

clue.text: Strike a blow at one's wrist?

definitions.meaning: to hit someone with an open hand
the end of a sleeve that wraps the wrist

explanation.definitionFit: A light slap is a cuff, and the band at the end of a sleeve also bears the name.

clue.text: The case, grammatically speaking, for the prosecution?

definitions.meaning: the grammatical case of a direct object
accusing someone, as a prosecutor does

explanation.definitionFit: The objective case in grammar, and a word meaning accusing, as the prosecution is.

clue.text: Is vested in teams of sappers.

parts.note: RE, the Royal Engineers, are the army's sappers
teams are sides

explanation.surface: Authority is held by groups of army engineers.
explanation.definitionFit: Power that resides in someone is vested in or belongs to them.

clue.text: Plan to 'bring 'succour, revealing a country's ups and downs?

definitions.text: revealing a country's ups and downs?

parts.note: succour is help or relief
a plan of an area is a map

explanation.surface: A scheme to bring aid shows a country's fortunes rising and falling.
explanation.definitionFit: This kind of chart shows hills and valleys in raised form or shading.

clue.text: General instruction have to follow by the shortest way

indicators.note: the second piece is told to come after the first

parts.note: going direct is going by the shortest route
I've is a contraction of I have

explanation.surface: An order from the general must be obeyed by the quickest route.
explanation.definitionFit: A directive is an official order or instruction.

clue.text: Ask for rent — tea is provided

indicators.note: the letters are provided in a fresh arrangement, so they are reworked

explanation.surface: A request for payment of rent when tea is laid on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'provided' signals that RENT and TEA are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: To entreat is to beg or plead for something.

clue.text: The piano repaired is of foreign origin

indicators.note: repairing puts the parts back together differently, so the letters are reworked

parts.note: Is. is the abbreviation for island, giving its initial I

explanation.surface: A piano that has been mended was made abroad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'repaired' rearranges THEPIANO; the extra I comes from 'is' taken as an abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: Ethiopian means from Ethiopia, which to a British solver is a foreign land.

clue.text: Results in certain splendours

indicators.note: read as in a certain other order, signalling the letters are reworked

explanation.surface: Outcomes shine with a particular glory.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in certain' signals that the letters of RESULTS are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Lustres are glories or brilliant sheens.

clue.text: Bone belonging to a monster numbered-among the most savage of creatures.

indicators.note: the letters belong to these words, sitting inside them across the gap

explanation.surface: A bone from a monster counted among the fiercest beasts.
explanation.definitionFit: The breastbone in the chest is this bone.

clue.text: Additional skin and hair at that point is incomplete.

parts.note: an animal's pelt, skin and hair, is fur

indicators.note: the word is cut short, losing its final letter

parts.note: at that point means there

explanation.surface: Extra skin and hair at that spot is unfinished.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is incomplete' drops the final E of THERE.
explanation.definitionFit: Further means additional, as in further details.

clue.text: Everything in the Cockney object is on the decline!.

indicators.note: one piece goes in the middle of the other

parts.note: a Cockney says thing as fing
everything is all

explanation.surface: In a Cockney's view, everything is going downhill.
explanation.walkthrough: Cockney is the London working-class accent, which turns th into f, so thing becomes FING.
explanation.definitionFit: Something falling is declining or dropping.

clue.text: Sanctimonious legislation applied to food in the East.

parts.note: pi is short for pious, meaning sanctimonious
legislation is law

explanation.surface: Self-righteous laws are made about eating in the Orient.
explanation.definitionFit: Pilaw is a variant spelling of pilaf, a rice dish of the Middle East.

clue.text: Something to read in reserve.

definitions.meaning: to reserve a seat or table

explanation.definitionFit: A volume one reads, and a verb meaning to reserve a place in advance.

clue.text: Continues to make strongholds

explanation.definitionFit: It means carries on, and the fortified towers at the heart of castles.

clue.text: Yes, abroad couple of final letters' delineate modern music.

parts.note: ja is German for yes
Z is the last letter of the alphabet, so two of them

explanation.surface: Foreign approval and a pair of last letters describe modern music.
explanation.definitionFit: Jazz is a modern musical style born in the twentieth century.

clue.text: A very large number go by motorway to meet a double headed beast!

parts.note: the M1 is Britain's main motorway, written MI
a lion whose head, its first letter, is doubled

explanation.surface: Take the motorway to meet a two-headed monster!
explanation.walkthrough: The M1 is the motorway from London to Leeds.
explanation.definitionFit: A million is a thousand thousands, a very large number.

clue.text: Fancy!

parts.note: an exclamation of surprise, as in 'just think of that!'

explanation.definitionFit: Both are exclamations of surprise, like 'just think!'

clue.text: Cosmetic journals with explosive contents?

parts.note: face powder is a cosmetic
periodical journals are magazines

explanation.surface: Beauty periodicals with sensational articles.
explanation.definitionFit: These are stores for gunpowder and ammunition, so their contents explode.
